summary: DynaResource, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its Mexican subsidiary received a US$4.0 million cash refund from Mexico's tax authority (SAT) for value-added tax (IVA) credits. The refund follows SAT's approval of MXN 75.0 million (~US$4.4 million) for H1 2025. Cash received was MXN 69.5 million on September 2, 2026; the balance was settled administratively. Outstanding IVA receivables remain ~MXN 425 million (~US$24.9 million) under review. This is a routine operational/tax matter, not a special situation.
